name: orbio-guard
description: Local-first credit controls for Orbio-powered AI agents.

scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:ui && npm run build:cloudflare && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.cloudflare:dev: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages dev cloudflare/dist
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy cloudflare/dist --project-name orbio-guard
scripts.cloudflare:live:dev: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler dev --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.cloudflare:live:deploy: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.worker.toml
